waivers.asked: At 9 runs, Monthly Budget and Unit Converter pass NT's gate. The four loan tools average about 3.5 on the filled screen, so they miss the bar of 4, whatever the wording. How should they ship?
waivers.said: Ship it all make sure design is good
waivers.why: On the 2026-11-05 record the first-time reader gave the filled screen [3, 3, 3, 3, 4, 3, 3, 3, 3] (middle score 3; 1 of 9 runs at 4 or more). Copy changes moved this score between 3 and 4 with no trend. The empty screen and the design rubric pass, so only the filled screen is waived, and a score under 3 still fails.
